rules.name: Vickers HMG Mount
rules.description: Heavy MG Teams on board a Bren Carrier are able to mount their Vickers HMG onto the vehicle, and fire it as a Vehicle MG - Pintle.  When they disembark, they take the HMG with them; the Bren Carrier loses this weapon, but retains its Hull LMG.  If the Heavy MG Team reboards, they may remount the Vickers.

rules.name: Bren Carrier Team
rules.description: The Rifle Team in a Bren Carrier Section has a single Bren gun- this is the same weapon mounted in the carrier.  When the Rifle Team disembarks, they take the Bren with them- the carrier no longer has a weapon and can't fire.

rules.name: Cromwell Tank Troop - Firefly Variant
rules.description: This is a varaint Cromwell Troop equipped with Fireflies instead of a Challenger, as defined in Dispatches 2.

rules.name: Dispirited Enemy
rules.description: The morale of the enemy facing you today is already shaky.  At the start of the German player's first turn he must automatically take a battle counter.

sharedRules.name: APDS Ammo
sharedRules.description: A 6-pounder anti-tank gun can fire a single shot of armour piercing discarding sabot (APDS) ammunition per game.  A hit from this ammo increases the 6-pdr's AP penetration value by 3, but the ammunition also affects the weapon's accuracy.  The aimed fire attack using the APDS shot has a -1 to hit.
